description.value: Newton Pizza is a local pizza chain with a White Rock/South Surrey location on King George Boulevard, offering 36 specialty pizzas across multiple crust styles and sauces, plus wings, sides, and salads. The air-conditioned dine-in space and online ordering make it a practical meal stop along the King George corridor. It is one of three Surrey-area locations operated by the same brand.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active pizza restaurant at #108, 2570 King George Hwy, Surrey with phone (604) 538-0444, corroborating the OSM record. OSM tags provide explicit signals on key amenities: takeaway=yes, diet:vegan=yes, diet:vegetarian=yes, toilets=no, and internet_access=no, used as primary evidence where the website does not elaborate. No bike parking information appears in either OSM tags or website content.
concerns: OSM tag toilets=no indicates no customer washrooms — a significant gap for a WWC cycling listing; nearest public washrooms are unidentified.

Website copyright is 2017; content may not fully reflect current amenities, though the business appears operationally active and online ordering is functional.
